scenes.title: A Glowing Surprise
scenes.body: One morning, a little fox found a tiny glowing seed on the windowsill. It sparkled like a drop of sunshine. The fox's eyes grew wide with curiosity.
scenes.altText: Scene 1 of a story about curiosity.

scenes.title: The Sparkly Trail
scenes.body: The seed left a trail of little sparkles across the meadow. The fox hopped over rocks and under leaves, following the shiny path. Every step brought a new happy sound.
scenes.altText: Scene 2 of a story about curiosity.

scenes.title: A Garden of Wonders
scenes.body: The fox planted the seed in a soft patch of earth. Soon a star-shaped flower bloomed and glowed in the moonlight. The little fox curled up beside it and fell asleep, dreaming of tomorrow's wonders.
scenes.altText: Scene 3 of a story about curiosity.
